description: This file defines the GlueClient class within the Aws\Glue namespace, which is used to interact with the AWS Glue service. It includes method annotations for various AWS Glue operations, both synchronously and asynchronously, serving as a client interface in the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: GlueClient
classes.description: Client class used for interacting with AWS Glue, extending the generic AwsClient class and providing methods for various Glue operations.

methods.name: batchCreatePartition
methods.description: Creates partitions in a Glue data catalog table.

methods.name: batchCreatePartitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates partitions in a Glue data catalog table.

methods.name: batchDeleteConnection
methods.description: Deletes multiple connection definitions in AWS Glue.

methods.name: batchDeletePartition
methods.description: Deletes partitions in a data catalog table.

methods.name: batchDeleteTable
methods.description: Deletes multiple tables from the data catalog.

methods.name: batchGetCustomEntityTypes
methods.description: Retrieves information about custom entity types.

methods.name: batchGetDataQualityResult
methods.description: Gets data quality results for a set of specified results.

methods.name: batchGetDevEndpoints
methods.description: Returns a list of all AWS Glue.dev endpoint resources.

methods.name: batchGetJobs
methods.description: Returns a list of AWS Glue job descriptions.

methods.name: batchGetPartition
methods.description: Returns information about a set of partitions.

methods.name: batchGetTableOptimizer
methods.description: Gets an array of resources with their corresponding status.

methods.name: batchPutDataQualityStatisticAnnotation
methods.description: Batch inserts Data Quality Statistic Annotations.

methods.name: batchPutDataQualityStatisticAnnotationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously batch inserts Data Quality Statistic Annotations.

methods.name: batchStopJobRun
methods.description: Stops one or more job runs.

methods.name: cancelDataQualityRuleRecommendationRun
methods.description: Cancels a data quality rule recommendation run.

methods.name: cancelDataQualityRuleRecommendationRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a data quality rule recommendation run.

methods.name: cancelDataQualityRulesetEvaluationRun
methods.description: Cancels a data quality ruleset evaluation run.

methods.name: cancelDataQualityRulesetEvaluationRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a data quality ruleset evaluation run.

methods.name: cancelMLTaskRun
methods.description: Cancels a machine learning transform run.

methods.name: cancelMLTaskRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels an ML task run.

methods.name: checkSchemaVersionValidity
methods.description: Checks if a schema version is valid.

methods.name: createCustomEntityTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a custom entity type.

methods.name: createDataQualityRulesetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a data quality ruleset.
